name: dreame
description: Control a Dreame robot vacuum through the Dreame cloud.
instructions:
- Fill in username and password; set account_type to the app you registered the vacuum in and country to the region the ACCOUNT was created in, not where you live. A wrong region looks like a wrong password, or gives an empty device list.
- Region support differs by brand: dreame supports eu, us, cn, sg, ru, kr; mova supports eu, us, cn, sg; trouver supports eu, us, ru, sg.
- Press a button on the robot to wake it before the first command. A sleeping vacuum drops its WiFi link and the cloud then rejects commands with error 80001.
- The plugin handles one vacuum per account.
- Setup runs in the background for up to a minute after install. Tools report that setup is still running until it finishes.

account_type.description: Which phone app your vacuum is registered in. "dreame", "mova", or "trouver".

username.description: The email address you log into that app with.

country.description: The region your account was created in: eu, us, cn, sg, ru, or kr.
